description:
Phase R consolidation (2026-05-06) — universal portal-agnostic refresh dispatcher. Replaces 5 deleted Defender-*-Refresh timer functions AND avoids per-portal duplication for v0.2.0+ (Entra/Purview/Intune). Runs every 1 minute; reads XdrTierState Storage table for ALL enabled (Portal, Tier) pairs; for each whose nextRunUtc <= now, calls Start-NewOrchestration -InputObject @{Portal=

;Tier=;FunctionName='Xdr-Refresh'} and updates nextRunUtc = now + cadence (per Get-XdrTierCadenceMap).
